items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: In the saxophone section, as I say, we had Darnell Howard, Omer Simeon on lead sax... And I was on string bass. Yeah, we were together about two or three years.

ctx.x: I started arranging when I was with Tate. I started arranging like Omer Simeon would arrange the saxaphone chords, I'd arrange the brass chords. They'd have what they called special courses. That's when I first started arranging.
What attracted you about tuba writing?
